name: Figr
description:
Bring over the UI, component code, and the thinking behind each design.

Figr is an AI product designer for teams working on existing products. It keeps your screens, design system, code, and the decisions that shaped the work together.

With the Figr connector, Claude can read that context directly inside a conversation. Share a project and Claude can:

Walk through its screens, artifacts, and source files
Read the code behind any component or screen
Explain why a design looks and works the way it does, including the trade-offs discussed along the way
Search the project’s code and conversation history
Use what it learns to write specs or create new screens that feel like part of the same product

The connector is read-only. Claude can understand and work with your Figr projects, but it can’t change them. It only has access to projects from your account.

Your prototypes, flows, code, and product context can now follow you into Claude, so you don’t have to explain everything from scratch.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Figr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Figr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.figr.design/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Figr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Figr provides these MCP tools: get_design_context, grep, ls, ping, read, set_design_system, set_project, stat, and tree.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Figr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Figr in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Figr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Figr is developed by Figr. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
